methods.label: Use a nonnegative difference square
methods.explanation:
The product is fixed, so compare the square of the sum with four times the product. Since \((x-y)^2\ge0\),
\[
(x+y)^2=(x-y)^2+4xy\ge64.
\]
Because \(x+y>0\), this gives \(x+y\ge8\). Equality occurs at \(x=y=4\), which satisfies \(xy=16\), so the minimum is \(8\).
methods.levelReason: A perfect-square identity and the positivity of the sum establish the bound using elementary algebra.
